titre: Behind this course, a trainer. Here is their background.
intro: Credibility built on hands-on practice across the SAP Ariba ecosystem, not on a generic presentation.
parcours: A consultant specialising in the SAP Ariba ecosystem for several years, who has worked on Procure-to-Pay and Source-to-Pay projects for organisations of varying sizes.
legitimite: Certified on the platform's key modules, with regular practice in tenders, catalogues and approval workflows.
approche: A practice-led approach to teaching: every concept is tied to a real use case before the learner puts it into practice.
